links.outcome: LLM vs radiologists and other LLMs on error detection and task time, same reports
links.effect: Error instance exact category recall 0.96 vs 0.45-0.67 for radiologists (P<.001); mean task time 5.80 vs 55.80-67.80 seconds per report.
links.quote: In the text-only review task, the model achieved higher exact category recall and shorter task completion times than the participating radiologists.

links.outcome: Performance drop at a new site in an independent external cohort
links.effect: Center 2 balanced accuracy was 0.94 (95% CI 0.92-0.95); performance remained stable across centers.

unlisted_practices: LLM-assisted quality assurance review of radiology report text for errors

screen.reason: Retrospective multicenter evaluation and head-to-head comparison of LLMs versus radiologists for radiology report quality assurance without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or comparing workflow interventions.
